description: Read an RSS, Atom or JSON feed as clean JSON: title, link, date, author, plain-text summary, image and podcast audio per item. Give a site's home page and the feed is found for you; give a date to get only what is new. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Site checks: Fast checks on any site without a browser: HTTP headers with a security grade and the redirect chain, TLS certificate and expiry, DNS records with mail setup (SPF, DMARC), what a site is built with and its contacts, robots.txt and AI crawler access, and a crawl that finds broken links and builds a sitemap..

since.description: Only items published after this date (ISO 8601): what is new since the last check.

url.description: A feed (RSS, Atom or JSON Feed), or a page that links to one: the feed is found from the page.

name: net_tools_feed
